mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with building a guest home in San Marcos?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a guest home in San Marcos varies significantly based on size, design complexity, finishes, and site preparation. Factors like utility connections (water, sewer, electricity), foundation work, and landscaping also contribute to the overall expense. While a basic studio guest home might start from a certain price point, a larger, custom-designed two-bedroom unit with high-end finishes will naturally be more expensive. It's best to discuss your specific needs and property conditions with our team for a tailored estimate.
